mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_user_memory (user_id, memory_type, memory_key, content, importance, confidence, status, seen_count, valid_from, source_conversation_id, source_message_id, source_quote, extractor_version, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{memoryType}, #{memoryKey}, #{content}, #{importance}, #{confidence}, #{status}, 1, #{validFrom}, #{sourceConversationId}, #{sourceMessageId}, #{sourceQuote}, #{extractorVersion}, #{expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, memory_type, memory_key) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, importance = GREATEST(ai_user_memory.importance, EXCLUDED.importance), confidence = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.confidence, ai_user_memory.confidence), status = CASE WHEN ai_user_memory.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE EXCLUDED.status END, valid_from = CASE WHEN ai_user_memory.content IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.content THEN now() ELSE ai_user_memory.valid_from END, seen_count = ai_user_memory.seen_count + 1, source_conversation_id = EXCLUDED.source_conversation_id, source_message_id = EXCLUDED.source_message_id, source_quote = EXCLUDED.source_quote, extractor_version = EXCLUDED.extractor_version, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, memory_key, content, importance, confidence, status, seen_count, valid_from, source_conversation_id, source_message_id, source_quote, extractor_version, expires_at, last_used_at, hit_count, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND memory_type != 'TEMPORARY' AND importance >= #{minImportance} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()) ORDER BY importance DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, memory_key, content, importance, confidence, status, seen_count, valid_from, source_conversation_id, source_message_id, source_quote, extractor_version, expires_at, last_used_at, hit_count, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, memory_key, content, importance, confidence, status, seen_count, valid_from, source_conversation_id, source_message_id, source_quote, extractor_version, expires_at, last_used_at, hit_count, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_user_memory SET content = #{content}, importance = #{importance}, valid_from = CASE WHEN status = 'CANDIDATE' THEN now() ELSE valid_from END, status = 'ACTIVE', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
